definitions.explanation: A natural or synthetic substance used in manufacturing. Natural resin comes from trees, while synthetic resin (plastic) is widely used in modern products. In everyday Japanese, often refers to plastic materials.

examples.japanese: この{製品|せいひん}は{樹脂|じゅし}でできている。
examples.english: This product is made of resin.

examples.japanese: {樹脂|じゅし}{製|せい}のケースは{軽|かる}くて{丈夫|じょうぶ}だ。
examples.english: Resin cases are light and durable.

examples.japanese: {天然|てんねん}{樹脂|じゅし}と{合成|ごうせい}{樹脂|じゅし}では{性質|せいしつ}が{大|おお}きく{異|こと}なる。
examples.english: Natural resin and synthetic resin have very different properties.

notes:
USAGE:
In product descriptions and technical contexts, {樹脂|じゅし} often means "plastic" or "polymer." On product labels, {樹脂|じゅし}{製|せい} indicates the item is made of plastic/resin. Common in descriptions of watches, phone cases, and household items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合成|ごうせい}{樹脂|じゅし} (synthetic resin, plastic)
- {天然|てんねん}{樹脂|じゅし} (natural resin)
- {樹脂|じゅし}{製|せい} (made of resin/plastic)
- {樹脂|じゅし}{加工|かこう} (resin processing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- プラスチック: plastic — the everyday loanword
- {樹脂|じゅし}: resin/plastic — more technical, used in product specs and manufacturing
